summary: Blends, sequences, and scripts animation clips from Clip CHOPs listed in a DAT, with root transform targeting and playback controls.
key_concepts: Clip Blender CHOP is a TouchDesigner Pro engine for blending, sequencing, and scripting animation clips formatted as Clip CHOPs.
The operator reads Clip CHOP paths from a Table DAT list, pops each clip as it plays, and loops the last clip when the list becomes empty.
All Clip CHOPs loaded into one Clip Blender must have the same channel count, matching channel names, and the same sample rate to avoid animation glitches.
FBX and USD animation clips generally need to be extracted from the asset hierarchy and loaded separately into Clip CHOPs before blending.
The Target and root transform channel parameters work with Clip CHOP Blend To Target modes to steer root translation and rotation.
Info CHOP and Info DAT are the documented way to inspect current Clip Blender state.

key_params.name: datlist
key_params.note: Table DAT list of Clip CHOP paths

key_params.name: target
key_params.note: Root-transform target used by Blend To Target clips

key_params.name: reset
key_params.note: Reset and hold ready to play the default Clip CHOP

key_params.name: resetpulse
key_params.note: Instantly reset and start playing the default Clip CHOP

common_gotchas: Official docs mark Clip Blender CHOP as TouchDesigner Pro-only.
Every Clip CHOP loaded into the same Clip Blender must have matching channel counts, channel names, and sample rates.
The DAT list is consumed as clips play; once empty, the last animation in the sequence loops.
FBX or USD animation clips generally need to be extracted into Clip CHOPs before blending.
Use Info CHOP or Info DAT for current playback state instead of inferring state from the DAT list alone.
